extracted.name: Confectioners' Sugar
extracted.description: Make your own confectioners' sugar with this quick and easy DIY recipe that calls for two ingredients. No powdered sugar in the house? No problem!
instruction_lines: Combine sugar and cornstarch together in a blender or food processor. Pulse until mixture has the powdery consistency of confectioners' sugar.
